t: Easyfix galvanised XL head clout nails provide secure and durable fastening for a range of construction tasks. These galvanised roofing nails are specifically engineered with an extra-large head to offer excellent hold and prevent pull-through, making them ideal for securing roofing felt, shingles, and other roofing materials. The galvanised finish delivers excellent corrosion resistance, ensuring suitability for both indoor and outdoor applications, even in challenging weather conditions. Each 1kg pack contains approximately 350 nails, providing tradesmen with a reliable supply of these essential fixings.
b: XL Head Secures Materials & Prevents Pull-Through
Strong Holding Power With 3 x 40mm Size
